name: pokeemerald-vita-3ds
description: Native PS Vita port of pokeemerald with Emerald 3DS features (no ROM included)
long_description: Unofficial native PS Vita port of Pokémon Emerald, built from the pret/pokeemerald decompilation. It is not an emulator: the game's C code is compiled for the Vita's ARM CPU, and a platform layer supplies what the GBA hardware did. On top of it, the port brings the features of Emerald 3DS to the Vita with vitaGL, plus an optional
